name: Cryptography
description: Cryptography module for WSO2 Integrator: MI. Provides in-line OpenPGP (RFC 9580 / RFC 4880) encrypt, decrypt, sign, verify and the combined sign-then-encrypt / decrypt-then-verify message-mediation operations, built on Bouncy Castle.

operations.name: pgpEncrypt
operations.description: Encrypt the input for a recipient using their PGP public key.

operations.name: pgpDecrypt
operations.description: Decrypt the input using your PGP private key and passphrase.

operations.name: pgpSign
operations.description: Sign the input with your PGP private key.

operations.name: pgpVerify
operations.description: Verify a signed message with the sender's PGP public key.

operations.name: pgpSignAndEncrypt
operations.description: Sign with your private key, then encrypt for the recipient (outbound).

operations.name: pgpDecryptAndVerify
operations.description: Decrypt with your private key, then verify the sender's signature (inbound).
